sources: Stack Influence, 5 TikTok monetization paths (Jun 2026): $0.40-$1.00 per 1,000 qualifying views, third-party report, not official

beats.say: One million views on TikTok. That sounds like a paycheck.
Creator Rewards reportedly pays [$0.40|forty cents] to [$1|one dollar] per [1,000|thousand] qualifying views.
So a million views is about [$400|four hundred] to [$1,000|a thousand dollars]. Not bad, right?
To join, you need [10,000|ten thousand] followers and [100,000|a hundred thousand] views in thirty days.
At [600|six hundred] followers, those million views pay you zero from Creator Rewards.
That's why small creators get paid other ways first.
Find yours free on subcreatorpaid.com. Pick your size, your platform and what you enjoy.
The AI Income Finder matches you: a newsletter, Substack, or a Gumroad product, with zero followers needed.
Views are the bonus. Direct pay comes first. Case closed.
